info.title: API.SH: Cricbuzz
info.description: The Cricbuzz API from API.SH: public Cricbuzz data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Ball-by-ball commentary of a match, newest first: commentary text (plain and with its formatting), over and ball, time, events (four, six, wicket, ...), batter and bowler ids and names, end-of-over summaries (runs in the over, score, batters' and bowler's figures) and linked video clips. The first page without `innings` also carries the match header. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null at the start of the match.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cricbuzz-commentary

get.summary: Cricbuzz live, recent and upcoming matches
get.description:
Live, recent or upcoming cricket matches as listed on Cricbuzz, grouped by series and filtered by type (international, league, domestic, women). Each match: match and series id, description, format, start/end time, state and status text, both teams with every innings score (runs, wickets, overs, declared, follow-on), venue (ground, city, timezone, coordinates), the batting side and a link. `series` lists each series with its match ids.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cricbuzz-matches

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Match type: all (default), international, league, domestic, women.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Cricbuzz player profile and career stats
get.description:
A player's profile: name, role, batting and bowling style, date and place of birth, height, teams, image, a short bio summary, current and best ICC rankings (batting, bowling, all-rounder per format), career batting and bowling stats for every format the player played (Test, ODI, T20I, IPL, ...: matches, innings, runs, balls, highest, average, strike rate, 4s, 6s, 50s, 100s, 200s, wickets, economy, best figures, 5w/10w ...), debut and last match per format, and recent batting and bowling form.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cricbuzz-player

parameters.description: Cricbuzz player id (1413 = Virat Kohli; from squads, rankings or a profile URL).

get.description:
Every innings a player batted or bowled, with the site's filters (format, tournament, team, opponent, venue, year) and sort, plus a summary of the filtered set (matches, innings, runs, average, strike rate, 50s, 100s, wickets, economy, best figures ...) and the filter options available for the player. Each row: match id and link, series, score or figures, opponent, format, venue, date, strike rate or economy, 4s and 6s. International, IPL and WPL matches. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cricbuzz-player-matches

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
